name: jumia-mcp
description: Jumia (ecommerce channels): me, set_inventory, list_orders. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint

platform_mcp_jumia_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_JUMIA_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_jumia_client_id.description: Client Id of a SELF AUTHORIZATION application registered in Vendor Center > Settings > Applications (Web Applications cannot refresh unattended).

platform_mcp_jumia_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_JUMIA_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_jumia_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from the application's 'Generate Token' action in Vendor Center. Every refresh returns a NEW refresh token; the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/jumia.json (0600) so a restart uses the latest one.

tools.name: me
tools.description: get-shops returns the shops of the authenticated user [{id, name, email, businessClients[{code (e.g. jumia-ng), countryCode, status}]}].

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: Update Product Stock feed {products: [{sellerSku, id, stock}]}: BOTH `sku` (your seller SKU) and `listing_id` (the Jumia product SID, a uuid) are required by the endpoint. Asynchronous: raw.feedId, status at GET /feeds/{id}.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Retrieve Orders ?status(PENDING|READY_TO_SHIP|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|FAILED|CANCELED|RETURNED, comma-separated)&createdAfter(YYYY-MM-DD or 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss'; createdBefore defaults to today, max 3-month window)&size. Paging is by the response's next-page token, so only the first page is returned. raw.number is the customer-facing order number; totals are in the local currency.
